extDescription.message: Save ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini chats to your GitHub repo as Markdown — with a git-like commit and push.

copyLink.message: Copy link to the file on GitHub

autoPushHint.message: Push right after each commit. Turns on auto commit too.

clientIdHint.message: Leave empty to use the built-in app. Set your own to sign in through a GitHub App or OAuth App you control (enable device flow on it).

errAuth.message: GitHub didn't accept the sign-in. Connect again.

errBadToken.message: GitHub didn't accept this token. Check the token and its permissions.

errDenied.message: The request was denied on GitHub.

errNetwork.message: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection.

errNoPermission.message: This account can't write to that repository.

errNoReply.message: gitchat's background stopped responding. Try again.

errRateLimit.message: GitHub's rate limit was reached. Try again in a few minutes.

errRepoExists.message: A repository with that name already exists.

obConnectBody.message: Sign in so gitchat can write to the repository you choose.

obDoneBody.message: Open a chat and hover the widget on the right edge to start saving it.

obPoint1.message: One chat is one Markdown file — math, code and visualizations included.

obPoint2.message: A git-like flow: changes stage themselves; you commit and push.

obPoint3.message: Hand a whole chat to another AI agent with a single link.

obPrefsBody.message: You can change these any time in settings.

obRepoBody.message: A private repository is recommended — chats often contain personal details.

obWelcomeBody.message: gitchat saves your ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini conversations as Markdown. Your chats go only to your own GitHub repository.

obWelcomeTitle.message: Keep your AI chats in your own repository

popNewChat.message: Send a message to start this chat, then save it from here.

popOpenChat.message: Open a chat to save it.

popSetupLead.message: Save your AI chats to your own GitHub repository.

repoNotEmptyWarn.message: This repository already has files. gitchat can use it only if it already holds a gitchat archive.

repoPublicWarn.message: This repository is public: anyone could read your chats.

resetHint.message: Signs out on this device and restores the defaults. Your repository is not changed.

saveVisualizationsHint.message: Keep the HTML of interactive charts and artifacts as files next to the chat.

errRepoNotEmpty.message: This repository already has files that gitchat did not create. Choose an empty repository, or let gitchat create a new one.

tokenStepRepo.message: Create an empty private repository for your chats.

tokenStepToken.message: Create a fine-grained token. Under Repository access, choose Only select repositories and pick that repository. The Contents permission is filled in for you.

tokenStepPaste.message: Paste the token here. It is stored only on this device.

repoPatNote.message: A token limited to selected repositories can't create repositories. Create the repository on GitHub, give your token access to it, then choose it under Existing repository.

repoMissingHint.message: Not in the list? Check that your token has access to it, or type owner/name above.

widgetName.message: gitchat: saving status of this chat

errInitIncomplete.message: Couldn't load the whole chat, so nothing was saved. Try again.

errInitBusy.message: The answer is still running. Start saving again when it has finished.

errInitEmpty.message: No answers were found in this chat, so nothing was saved.

errInitOtherTab.message: This chat is already being saved in another tab.

errInitStale.message: This capture was cancelled or replaced. Start again.

errRefresh.message: Couldn't read the chat, so nothing was committed or pushed. Wait for the answer to finish (or reload the tab) and try again.

aiStalled.message: The answer seems stuck. It will be saved once it finishes.

errCaptureFailed.message: Couldn't read the latest messages, so nothing was committed or pushed. Try again.

errInitCoverage.message: Some messages could not be read, so nothing was saved. Try again.

shotRepo.message: ① Name (filled in) · ② Private · ③ Create repository
shotRepo.description: Caption of the GitHub new-repository screenshot

shotAccess.message: ① Only select repositories · ② pick the repository you just created
shotAccess.description: Caption of the token repository-access screenshot

shotPermissions.message: ① Contents: Read and write and ② Metadata: Read-only are filled in · ③ Generate token, then copy the token
shotPermissions.description: Caption of the token permissions screenshot

errInitStalled.message: Reading the chat stopped moving, so it was not saved. Scroll the chat a little and try again.

errInitPrevChat.message: The page still showed the previous chat, so nothing was saved. Wait until this chat has loaded and try again.

reloadExtensionHint.message: Loads the extension’s files again, for example after updating them with git pull. Reload open chat tabs afterwards.

signInDifferentAccount.message: Sign in with a different account

wrongTokenUseDifferent.message: Wrong token? Use a different one

tokenLacksAccess.message: This token probably can't write to this repository (check that it includes the repository and has Contents: Read and write).

tokenMayNotSeeRepo.message: This repository wasn't found, or this token can't see it (a token limited to other repositories gets the same answer).
